product_family: Adobe Marketo Engage is an enterprise marketing automation platform with core features for lead management, campaign orchestration, and analytics. Sub-products include Marketo Sales Connect, Marketo Sales Insight Actions, and Marketo Measure. Available in multiple pricing tiers with performance-based options.

certifications.name: SOC 2 Type 2
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Creative Cloud for enterprise holds SOC 2–Type 2 (Security, Availability, & Confidentiality), and Marketo Engage is included within Adobe Experience Cloud which carries the same certifications.

certifications.name: SOC 3
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Experience Cloud holds SOC 3 (Security, Availability, & Confidentiality) certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27001:2022
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Experience Cloud has achieved ISO 27001:2022 certification.

certifications.name: ISO 27017:2015
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Experience Cloud holds ISO 27017:2015 certification for cloud-specific security controls.

certifications.name: ISO 27018:2019
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Experience Cloud holds ISO 27018:2019 certification for cloud-based personal data protection.

certifications.name: ISO 22301:2019
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Experience Cloud has achieved ISO 22301:2019 certification for business continuity and disaster recovery.

certifications.name: ISO 9001:2015
certifications.proof_quote: Adobe Experience Cloud holds ISO 9001:2015 quality management certification.

certifications.name: GDPR
certifications.proof_quote: Marketo Engage offers tools to help comply with GDPR and supports data subject rights including Right to Access and Right to Erasure. A Data Processing Agreement (DPA) is available for customers.

certifications.name: CCPA (California Consumer Privacy Act)
certifications.proof_quote: Marketo Engage offers tools to help comply with CCPA and provides privacy controls for California residents.

certifications.name: HIPAA
certifications.proof_quote: Marketo Engage readily supports compliance with HIPAA through advanced tools and protections. However, all Add-ons are not HIPAA-ready and must not be used with data requiring additional HIPAA protections.

certifications.name: PCI DSS
certifications.proof_quote: No public certification or evidence of PCI DSS compliance on vendor domain. Platform uses strong encryption (AES 256-bit at rest, TLS 1.2+ in transit) suitable for payment processing contexts, but no official PCI DSS attestation found.

certifications.name: ISO/IEC 42001 (AI Governance)
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of ISO/IEC 42001 certification on vendor domain.

certifications.name: CSA STAR
certifications.proof_quote: No public evidence of CSA STAR certification on vendor domain.

privacy.ai_training_note: Adobe explicitly does not use customer data to train or fine-tune Azure OpenAI models. AI-generated outputs remain within the customer's Marketo Engage environment subject to existing residency, governance, and retention controls.
privacy.data_region: Multi-region: United States, United Kingdom, The Netherlands, Australia; Canada data center in development. Customers can control data residency through existing governance controls.

security.name: Encryption at Rest
security.value: AES 256-bit encryption for all data stored in Marketo Engage

security.name: Encryption in Transit
security.value: HTTPS with TLS 1.2 or greater for all data transmitted

security.name: Data Centers
security.value: Enterprise-class data centers from top-tier cloud hosting providers with fully redundant power and environmental systems

security.name: Incident Response
security.value: Adobe maintains an incident response program and security training for personnel

security.name: Business Continuity
security.value: Business continuity and disaster recovery capabilities verified by ISO 22301:2019 certification

products.name: Marketo Engage (Core)
products.data_scope: Lead database, campaign performance data, customer engagement metrics
products.notes: Main product offering; available in multiple pricing tiers with performance-based options (Standard, Performance, Performance Plus)

products.name: Marketo Sales Connect
products.data_scope: Sales activities, email engagement, call logging
products.notes: Includes GDPR-specific compliance card in Person Detail View; integrates with CRM systems

products.name: Marketo Sales Insight Actions
products.notes: Supports GDPR compliance requirements for sales teams

products.name: Marketo Measure
products.notes: Separate security documentation available; tracks multi-touch attribution

products.name: Marketo AI
products.data_scope: Marketing automation workflows, lead data for AI-assisted operations
products.notes: Native agentic AI within Engage for automation tasks; does not train on customer data; supports lead list import, program validation, data normalization, and analytics

compare.pricing_model: Subscription-based SaaS with multiple tiers; contact for pricing
compare.data_residency: Multi-region (US, UK, Netherlands, Australia) with customer control via DPA; Canada region in development

flags: HIPAA limitation: Add-ons are not HIPAA-ready and must not be used with PHI or HIPAA-regulated processes; core Marketo Engage is HIPAA-compliant but customers should verify add-on usage
Interactive Webinars feature: Customers cannot create, receive, maintain, or transmit PHI (Protected Health Information) in connection with Interactive Webinars events

While Marketo uses strong encryption (AES 256-bit) suitable for payment processing contexts, no official PCI DSS certification is publicly listed; companies in payment processing should verify PCI DSS readiness directly with Adobe
No AI governance certs: Despite having native AI features (Marketo AI), no ISO/IEC 42001 or CSA STAR AI certifications are publicly listed
